ConceptDef.label: The extraction gate
ConceptDef.helpText: The gate leads down to the next level. It stays sealed until its terminal is hacked. Then send the party through: colonists bring what they carry, and nothing else comes along.

ConceptDef.label: Terminals
ConceptDef.helpText: A colonist hacks a terminal by solving a code puzzle: pick the right access code from look-alikes. A higher Intellectual skill gives more attempts.

ConceptDef.label: Sealed hatches
ConceptDef.helpText: A coloured hatch opens from its terminal, or with the keycard of the same colour. A hatch with no colour belongs to a restricted wing and needs enough clearance at its terminal.

ConceptDef.label: Keycards
ConceptDef.helpText: A keycard opens the hatch of the same colour. A colonist has to carry it: right-click the card to pick it up, then select the hatch and use Swipe keycard.

ConceptDef.label: Clearance badges
ConceptDef.helpText: A colonist who carries a clearance badge raises the party's clearance on this level. Higher clearance opens restricted wings, and staff clearance makes the facility's defences friendly.
